prediction_cadence_policy: Positive integer divisor of original annotation period, aligned to clip start; complete stream required
onset_policy: Keep annotated interval unchanged; never round it to prediction cadence
continuous_interval: Optional active_interval_us plus continuous_motion_reviewed=true, at original annotation boundaries
matching: Proposal centre inside fixed native ROI; diagnostic only, not object AP or tracking recall
scope: Common M03/M05 train clips only; unmatched annotations reported as excluded outside comparison
no_annotations_policy: Validate streams and produce PENDING_ANNOTATIONS with no real quality score
